generatedProse.concept-context: In psychology, this one creative move appears across your studies. You might meet it in designing a study around a question with no standard method, in rethinking a revision strategy that has stopped working, or in reading a classic paper as one interpretation rather than settled fact. Each time, you generate a workable option, adapt it, and defend it.
generatedProse.worked-example: A psychology student faces three things in one module: a coursework question with no set method, a note-taking routine that has stalled, and a well-known study everyone cites as settled. At first she treats them as three separate problems. Then she notices the same creative move fits all three: propose an option, adapt it as she learns more, and defend it with evidence. Her design, her revision and her essay all grow sharper.
generatedProse.summary: In psychology, creativity works best as one deliberate practice. Whether you are designing a study, amending a revision strategy, or arguing a reading of a key paper, the move is the same: generate an option, adapt it, and defend it. The practice itself, used again and again, is what strengthens your work.

check.body: A researcher meets a stubborn problem, amends a stalled method, and argues a fresh reading of a key source, all in one project. What does this show?

items.text: Their next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved.
Nothing; feedback comes at the end, so it cannot affect anything that follows.
Only the mark on the first report, which cannot now change.
The deadline for the next report.

feedback.correct: That's right. Using the feedback fed back into the next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved: that is the cycle working.
feedback.incorrectNotFinal: Not quite. Think about what the student changed before the next report, not the old mark or the deadline.
feedback.incorrectFinal: Using the feedback fed back into the student's next round of learning and preparation, which is why the next report improved. The old mark cannot change and the deadline is not part of the cycle; feedback is not the end, it feeds the next turn.

_items.text: That creativity is one practice at work across the project: the same move of generating and defending a new option, in three different places.
_items.feedback: Yes. Attribute, self-regulation and scholarship are three faces of one creative practice.

_items.text: That the researcher was using three unrelated skills that happened to coincide.
_items.feedback: They are not unrelated. Each is the same creative move in a different arena.

_items.text: That creativity only counts when it appears in formal research.
_items.feedback: Creativity as one practice runs through everyday study too, not only research.

_items.text: That amending a method and reading a source have nothing to do with creativity.
_items.feedback: Both are creative moves: generating a better option and a fresh reading.
